visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black long-sleeved button-up shirt, is centered in the frame. He exhibits high-arousal facial expressions, wide mouth, and energetic hand gestures. The background is a digital composite of the Taipei night skyline with Taipei 101 brightly lit in blue and green. A '泛科學 NEWS' logo is in the top left. (2) A white overlay box appears in the center, displaying the title of a scientific article: 'The origin of vertebrate teeth and evolution of sensory exoskeletons' from the journal Nature. The man remains in the bottom third of the frame, gesturing upwards toward the text. (3) A complex scientific diagram with multiple labeled panels (a-l) showing anatomical cross-sections and microscopic views of different organisms is displayed. The man is still visible in a circular inset or at the bottom, explaining the diagrams. (4) The scene returns to a full view of the man speaking against the Taipei night skyline. He uses various hand signals to emphasize his points. (5) A 3D microscopic visualization of fossil structures is shown, featuring green cylindrical structures within a textured red and grey mass, labeled with 'dt', 'pc', and 'vc'. (6) The video concludes with the man speaking directly to the camera, pointing to his mouth and teeth, while the Taipei 101 background remains constant.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 牙齒前身是古魚的皮膚感知器？. [Subtitle]: 天啊 股市教科書又要被改寫了. (2) [Subtitle]: 而且這次尺度超大 對 字幕沒錯 是齒度. (3) [Subtitle]: 主角是寒武紀化石 Anatolepis 原本科學家深信它是最早的牙本質. (4) [Subtitle]: 是脊椎動物牙齒的關鍵成分 但如今已無法繼續鐵齒了. (5) [Subtitle]: 就在 5 月 21 日發表於 Nature 上的研究中 芝加哥大學科學家 Yara Haridy. (6) [Subtitle]: 透過同步輻射掃描發現 Anatolepis 的所謂牙本質小管 其實有箭頭狀末端和管中管形態. (7) [Subtitle]: 這些特徵經過比對 其實更像是節肢動物的感覺器官. (8) [Subtitle]: 沒錯 科學家發現 我們一直當脊椎動物老祖先拜的牙齒 其實更可能是三葉蟲蟲的毛.
